scope: Prospective capped Snake food-score comparison within one model and one runtime; additive and separate from CLEF discovery evidence

source.model_mode: Native non-thinking text generation; no CLEF head
source.artifact_gate: Exact source files, tokenizer/template, converter revision, generated GGUF hashes, tensor inventory and quantizer commands must be recorded before use.
source.converter_gate: Converter revision c25030496079fdad724609d94f68b859f25774ce, entry and observed dependencies are pinned in artifact-plan.json. Conversion and dependency compatibility remain unexecuted; verify generated BF16 GGUF and tied I/O before use.

runtime.implementation: standard upstream llama.cpp, not the CLEF patched bridge
runtime.hardware_backend: Apple Silicon Metal, same machine and binary for all variants
runtime.template: Exact native template from the pinned official model; no handwritten or substituted template
runtime.configuration_gate: Before any request, verify exact binary SHA256, server arguments and effective properties against expected_configuration; record template hash and converter provenance. Unsupported configuration or BF16 generation stops this version before main scores; no silent defaults, CPU fallback, automatic fit, context shift, or variant-specific changes.
runtime.configuration_status: Frozen prospective settings; option availability checked from installed binary help, but actual model compatibility and execution are unverified.
runtime.timeout_semantics: 120 seconds per request is an operational technical-stop threshold. It is not a gameplay clock budget, a collision, zero-food score, or permission to retry.

variants.derivation: Convert the pinned official checkpoint directly to BF16 GGUF; no intermediate lower precision
Quantize directly from the verified BF16 GGUF, retaining the shared input/output tensor in BF16
Quantize directly from the verified BF16 GGUF, retaining the shared input/output tensor in BF16

variant_verification.bf16_compatibility: Unverified. Stop if BF16 GGUF conversion, loading or generation is unsupported; F16 substitution requires a new version before any scored games.
variant_verification.quantization_scope: Controlled mixed backbone recipes retaining BF16 native tied I/O, not uniformly 4-bit/2-bit whole-model or off-the-shelf quantized files

game.question_and_factual_features: Unchanged Game.request().state and .questions, including unsafe-action information
game.food_protocol: clef-snake-food-v1 SHA256-keyed event priorities; same priorities per seed/event, coordinates may diverge with bodies
game.turn_semantics: Wait for one complete model response, validate it, persist evidence, then apply its action once. Invalid responses are technical stops. Collision calls count as attempts, not successful moves.

request.system_prompt: You control Snake using the supplied factual state and move question. Select exactly one of the four actions, including an unsafe action if that is your choice. Return only a JSON object with the single key "action" and one of "up", "down", "left", or "right". Do not include explanation, reasoning, Markdown, or text outside that JSON object.
request.user_content: JSON object in insertion order {state:Game.request().state,questions:Game.request().questions}; no CLEF model selector
request.history: Fresh system and user messages only on every turn; no prior completion or hidden game history

parser_contract.content: Strict JSON object containing only action, exactly one of up/down/left/right; no duplicate keys, extra fields, nonfinite values, Markdown, explanations or other text
parser_contract.usage: Nonnegative integer prompt/completion/total counts, total equals prompt+completion, completion <=32
parser_contract.raw_retention: Retain complete raw text; bytes retained losslessly as base64, including invalid UTF-8. No trimming, extraction, repair, retry, fallback, or action override.

design.sample_unit: Distinct saved environment seed, paired across all three variants
design.schedule_rule: All six permutations repeated five times in saved order; ten games per within-seed position per variant
design.run_rule: Strict execution_order; reload one model at a time between games as needed; setup timed separately; no parallel or interactive inference
design.preflight_rule: Separate six saved seeds; exactly one initial-state-only request per seed/variant; no scored rollout, tuning, outcome selection or main-seed calls; all execution requires separate authorization

outcome.primary: Food collected by collision or the 500-successful-move cap
outcome.contrast: Mean of paired per-seed food differences against BF16
outcome.caps: Retain capped food scores in defined capped-score estimand and report capped_alive separately; no uncapped-score claim
outcome.failures: Technical failures have outcome null/NA, never collision or zero; partial score diagnostic only
outcome.failure_policy: Stop at first technical issue; retain raw failure and all planned rows, remaining games not_started; no retry or implicit resume. Repair requires separately identified frozen version/phase, preserving failed evidence. Incomplete campaign has descriptive complete-pair summaries only, not planned confirmatory inference.

sign_flip.statistic: absolute sum of integer paired differences
sign_flip.rng: One NumPy Generator(PCG64(20261007)), comparison order q4-k-m then q2-k, exact branches consume no draws
sign_flip.draw_rule: Per replicate rng.integers(0,2,size=n,dtype=np.int64), zero -> -1, one -> +1; batching preserves flat sequence
sign_flip.extreme_rule: random absolute sum >= observed absolute sum
sign_flip.assumption: Exchangeable signs or symmetric paired differences under null; deterministic balanced schedule is not randomized treatment assignment

required_reporting: Monte Carlo extreme counts and uncertainty

gates_before_execution: Explicit authorization for any downloads, loading, preflight or campaign; this preparation alone authorizes none
Published pre-result freeze binding protocol, seeds, schedule, analysis plan, source, adapter and tests

Storage budget and exact artifact acquisition/conversion plan approved on the external Models storage partition identified in the resource plan, without deleting existing evidence; verify exact mount identity, destination and free space and forbid fallback to the internal volume
One pinned official source, BF16 baseline and BF16 tied I/O tensor equality verified; no silent F16 fallback
One pinned standard runtime plus the exact frozen expected_configuration, binary SHA256, server arguments, effective properties and template hash recorded
A bounded authorized preflight validates context fit, grammar/parser, native BF16 generation and evidence capture
